author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at Discord's age verification controversy. Discord has cut ties with the Persona as I expected but it has continued it's push for age verification even harder, while it's only delayed to the end of the year it's time to look at privacy respecting alternatives that put you in control and are affordable at the same time. Thanks for watching!
